newsitems.title: Drawquarium is Coming to Steam on November 13!
newsitems.author: roka_adrian
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! 👋I'm Kaleb, and I'm incredibly excited (and a little nervous) to finally announce thatDrawquarium is coming to Steam on November 13! I'm actually a 3D artist working in the film industry, and about 1.5 years ago, I had a little idea: What if I could bring my children's drawings to life?That idea became Drawquarium, my very first video game! I've poured my heart into this little project, creating all the artwork and animations myself.In Drawquarium, you can draw your own fish, import your own images (including your kids' drawings!), decorate your aquarium, and even turn it into a living desktop wallpaper!Watch Our Release Date Trailer!The trailer is a little longer and more story driven than usual, but hey, I come from the film industry. I couldn't help myself! 😅I really hope you enjoy it!Drawquarium launches November 13 on Steam!If you'd like to support this little project, adding it to your wishlist or sharing the trailer would mean the world to me.And if you want to follow development more closely:💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay🐦 X / Twitter: https://x.com/DrawquariumGame📷 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/drawquarium_game/🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@drawquarium_gameThank you so much for all the love and support! ❤️KalebProject i love to supportPlay solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends! Build a tower all the way to the Moon, deliver a powerful laser, and save humanity before it's too late!

newsitems.title: Drawquarium позволит оживить собственные рисунки и превратить их в уютный аквариум на рабочем столе
newsitems.contents: Инди-разработчик byKaleb и издатель rokaplay объявили дату выхода Drawquarium — расслабляющего симулятора, в котором игроки смогут рисовать собственных рыбок, оживлять их и создавать уникальный подводный мир. Игра выйдет 13 ноября 2026 года на PC в Steam, а уже сейчас можно попробовать бесплатную демоверсию. Главная особенность проекта — возможность самостоятельно создавать обитателей аквариума. Помимо рыб, можно нарисовать медуз, растения, замки, подводные лодки и даже космические корабли. Готовые изображения оживают после помещения в воду, а питомцев можно кормить, растить и наблюдать, как со временем они приобретают металлический блеск. Заботясь о рыбках, игроки будут собирать золотые чешуйки, открывающие новые украшения и варианты оформления аквариума. При этом Drawquarium не ограничивается обычным симулятором. Готовый аквариум можно установить в качестве анимированных обоев рабочего стола, чтобы нарисованные существа продолжали плавать во время работы или учёбы. В игру также встроены инструменты для продуктивности и отдыха: таймер Pomodoro, список задач, дневник, секундомер и часы. Поддерживается и импорт изображений в формате PNG, поэтому можно оживлять рисунки, созданные в других программах. Разработчик делает ставку на спокойный игровой процесс без соревнований и давления, позволяя каждому создавать собственный маленький мир в удобном темпе. Drawquarium выйдет 13 ноября 2026 года в Steam.

newsitems.title: 🎨🐠 Drawquarium Creative Event

newsitems.contents: It's time to get creative! 🫧 We're hosting a special Drawquarium Creative Event, and this is your chance to show off your artistic skills, win prizes and get your creations added to the game! During the Steam NEXT FEST the demo will still have plenty of features unlocked, so you can really give your submission extra love! After the event, the demo will be downgraded to a more "demo like" feature set. So now is the best time to give it a try and maybe even win something! 🐟 3 Categories to Get Creative! 🏝️ 1. Themed Aquarium Design an aquarium around a theme of your choice! Get creative with your underwater world and show us what you've got. Your aquarium needs to be new and named "NEXT FEST". 🎨 2. Favorite Creator Fish Draw a fish inspired by your favorite content creator! Make it recognizable, unique, and full of personality. Your fish also needs to be new, just to make it fair for everyone! 🌈 3. Wildcard Fish Create a fish that's funny, weird, beautiful, super realistic or completely unexpected. Let your imagination run wild! Your fish also needs to be new, just to make it fair for everyone! 🏆 Prizes & Rewards We're giving away 30 Steam keys in total! 🏅 10 winners per category: 5 Community Picks – chosen by community voting. The #1 Community Pick and #1 Kaleb's Pick from both the Favorite Creator Fish and Wildcard Fish categories will have the chance to become official fish in Drawquarium! 🐠 📅 Event Schedule 📢 Starts: October 19, 2026 – 6:00 PM (CEST) ⏰ Submission Deadline: October 26, 2026 – 6:00 PM (CET) 📍 Where: rokaplay Discord for Drawquarium in the submission forum 📜 How to Participate ✅ Create your artwork directly in Drawquarium. ✅ Submit your creation in our event forum and select the correct category tag. ✅ You can participate in all 3 categories, but only one submission per category is allowed. ✅ You can win a maximum of one Steam key per person, even if you place in multiple categories. ❌ No imported artwork. ❌ No AI-generated content. ❌ No inappropriate or non-family-friendly submissions. ❌ No copyrighted material. 👶 Participants must be 16 or older, or have parental consent if younger. ⚠️ Important: By submitting your creation, you agree that your artwork may be used for Drawquarium's marketing and may be added to the game. If featured, you'll be credited using your Discord username. 🚀 Ready to Make a Splash? Grab your creativity, fire up @drawquarium, and show us what you can create! 👉 Submit your creations here: rokaplay Discord for Drawquarium in the submission forum Good luck, have fun, and let your imagination swim wild! 🐠💙

newsitems.title: Drawquarium has changed a LOT since the demo in May 🐟
newsitems.author: roka_adrian
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! 👋Back in May, I released the first demo of Drawquarium. Since then, I have been working on the game pretty much nonstop, and a lot has changed.From the beginning, my goal with Drawquarium has been to create something that helps you slow down and relax. Something you can interact with whenever you feel like it, while your aquarium continues living peacefully in the background. That is also why the Wallpaper Mode is such an important part of the game.But there is another side to this. I still want Drawquarium to feel like a game. One of the most common pieces of feedback from the demo was that people loved the idea, enjoyed drawing their fish and watching the aquarium, but wanted more things to actually do.Which is exactly what I have been working on.So... what has changed? 🐠Here are some of the biggest additions and improvements since May:Breed your fish and create baby fish. Your fish can now reproduce, and they grow as you feed them.Fish are much more alive. They react to food, bubbles, new fish and their surroundings, and can get excited or scared.Aquariums now need a little care. Leftover food and debris stay inside the aquarium until you clean them up with your aquarium vacuum.Golden Scales introduce progression. Collect them and use them to unlock new brushes, templates and customization options.Aquariums are much more customizable. Change rocks, driftwood, water level, sand, colors and much more.Lighting can now be customized. Adjust the atmosphere of your aquarium and experiment with different lighting effects, and caustics.You can create bioluminescent fish and plants. Yes, your creations can glow now. ✨There is even a Disco Mode. Lasers, spotlights and techno music included. Because obviously every aquarium needs a nightclub.The drawing editor has been massively improved. The interface has been redesigned and drawing is smoother, faster and more intuitive.More drawing tools have been added. This includes zooming, improved Fill Bucket tools, stamps for textures, shapes, eyes and fins, custom templates and saved color palettes.You can edit your fish again later. Your creations are no longer permanently locked once you finish drawing them.Fish can have different animations, sizes and behaviors. There are now more ways to make each fish feel unique.You can grab your fish and drag them through the aquarium. Extremely important scientific feature.Fish can be moved between aquariums. There is also a global fish list where you can search for your creations by name.There is now an Idea Generator. If you have no idea what to draw next, Drawquarium can give you some inspiration.More music and ambient sounds have been added. You can mix different underwater and ambient sounds to create the atmosphere you want.Productivity tools are becoming part of Drawquarium. There is now a checklist, a journal, a timer and a clock with the current date and weekday.A new task list of gameplay goals gives you more direction. It provides a clearer path through the game while still letting you play at your own pace.Wallpaper Mode has received a lot of work. It is more reliable, audio continues properly when switching modes, and the aquarium is getting closer to the relaxing desktop companion I originally imagined.Performance, saving and stability have been improved. This includes automatic graphics detection, better performance, drawing autosaves and additional backup saves to protect your aquariums. Specifically, I created a much more robust save system so you won’t lose your creations for some technical reason.And there are many smaller improvements on top of all of this.Steam Next Fest🐟 Drawquarium will be part of the Steam Next Fest next month! I will share more details about when you can play it very soon.What would YOU like to see?Drawquarium is still evolving, and the feedback from the first demo has already influenced the game a lot.So please keep it coming. What would make you spend more time with your aquarium?What kind of activities would you like to have? What would make Wallpaper Mode more useful for you? Or is there something completely ridiculous you desperately want to put into your aquarium?Let me know in the comments. I read all of it. ❤️ And if you want to follow development more closely:💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay🐦 Follow us on X / Twitter: https://x.com/DrawquariumGame📷 Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/drawquarium_game/🎵 Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@drawquarium_game Thank you so much for playing the demo, sharing your fish and sending feedback.We’re nearing Drawquarium’s completion, so stay tuned!Kaleb ❤️

newsitems.title: The Demo Is Out Now
newsitems.author: roka_robert
newsitems.contents: Hey Drawquarium Community 👋,Yesterday I had to share some disappointing news: the demo was delayed.Today, I’m very happy to say that the wait is over.The Drawquarium demo is out now on Steam.Thank you for sticking with me through the unexpected delay and for all the support in the meantime. I originally wanted the demo reveal to be a fun surprise, and I’m relieved that I can finally share that surprise properly.You can now jump in, draw your own fish and other aquarium inhabitants, unlock new decorations, and watch your creations gain their metallic shimmer over time.If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist and follow Drawquarium on Steam. It really helps.Feel free to join my publisher’s Discord too Discord, I’d love to hear what you think.Cheers KalebPS: What do you think of the new trailer?

newsitems.title: The Demo Is Delayed
newsitems.author: roka_adrian
newsitems.contents: Hey Drawquarium Community 👋, This was actually meant to be a surprise for almost 35,000 people who have wishlisted Drawquarium. I wanted to announce the demo today, on Friday, April 17, and simply share the good news with all of you. But sadly, things did not go as planned. My demo submission did not go through because one required image was missing, and right now I am still waiting to hear back from Valve support. So somehow, this surprise ended up turning into an apology instead. What makes this even more unfortunate is that the announcement is already happening. Drawquarium is being featured in a showcase today, content creators are already talking about the game, and IGN is uploading a video that mentions the demo reveal as well.With full optimism, I am now aiming to move the demo release to next week. Thank you so much for all the kind words and positive feedback so far. It really means a lot to me. If you have not done so yet, please wishlist and follow Drawquarium here on Steam. That would help me a lot and I will make sure to share the new demo date as soon as I can.Feel free to join my publishers Discord, I'll be there to answer your questions or just hang out with you.Cheers Kaleb
